summary: Ultra Clean Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a Tenth Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement, refinancing $250 million in revolving credit commitments and extending the maturity to April 23, 2031. The amendment modifies interest rate margins based on the secured net leverage ratio, sets a maximum leverage covenant of 3.25x (or 3.75x post-material acquisition) and a minimum interest coverage ratio of 3.00x. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; it is a routine debt refinancing. Investors should monitor compliance with financial covenants but no risk-arb angle exists.
